<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

Multi-item scoring should process each item as an independent continuation of the shared query. This is the behavior requested in [#31969](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/31969) and enabled for Qwen3.5 GDN layers by [#33922](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33922).

The GDN item segments still include their synthetic starting delimiters. Full attention masks those delimiters out, but GDN convolution and recurrent updates consume them before the real item:

```text
Packed input: Q | D0 | I1 | D1 | I2 | D2
Current:      query-ending state -> D_i -> I_i
Expected:     query-ending state -> I_i
```

Changing a packing-only delimiter can therefore change an item's score. This follow-up excludes that delimiter from real-item GDN state updates without changing the Score API or packed input layout.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

- Process only tokens between adjacent delimiters for nonempty items. Preserve the existing one-token delimiter readout for empty items and omit the unobserved final delimiter.
- Keep query-once execution, independent item states, packed output shape, original-index scatter, and zero-initialized unprocessed slots.
- Update the independent convolution/recurrent references and metadata/pooling expectations.
- Add mixed real/empty-item GPU coverage and preserve actual 63/64/65-token item lengths in the chunk-boundary fixture.

## Reproduction

```bash
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B-Base \
  --revision 57370f0ea82c3cca33558a95212e032c344e5fd5 \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --enable-mis \
  --attention-backend flashinfer \
  --linear-attn-prefill-backend triton \
  --disable-radix-cache \
  --disable-cuda-graph \
  --chunked-prefill-size -1 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.8 \
  --language-only \
  --max-running-requests 16 \
  --max-prefill-tokens 30000 \
  --host 127.0.0.1 \
  --port 30000
```

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

Tested on one NVIDIA H200 with `Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B-Base` in BF16, TP1, FlashInfer full attention and Triton linear-attention prefill, using a source-matched compatibility runtime.

- Metadata and packed-position pooling: 5 tests passed.
- GDN GPU coverage: 4 tests passed, covering mixed/empty queries and items, 63/64/65-token chunk boundaries, and ordinary GDN behavior.
- The pre-fix source fails the corresponding metadata and numerical regressions.
- **Delimiter-only control:** with the query/items unchanged, marker changes through 9999/0/220/9999 give a maximum absolute probability change of **0.445098 before the fix, versus 0.000000 after**.
- Targeted formatting, static checks, syntax, CI registration and whitespace checks passed.

Synthetic parity uses 200 records with two items each (seed `20261027`): 400 pair-normalized positive probabilities compared with independent singleton requests to a separate MIS-disabled SIS server. Only this GDN fix is enabled in the candidate.

| Absolute difference vs SIS | Original MIS | This fix |
|---|---:|---:|
| Mean | 0.207190 | 0.012238 |
| P95 | 0.469942 | 0.029793 |
| P99 | 0.483114 | 0.051905 |
| Maximum | 0.495894 | 0.058688 |
| Outside descriptive criterion | 373/400 | 38/400 |

The descriptive criterion is `abs(MIS - SIS) <= 0.02 + 0.02 * abs(SIS)`. This measures implementation agreement with SIS.

<details>
<summary>Static checks</summary>

The following commands pass with Ruff 0.15.1 and isort 7.0.0:

```bash
files=(
  python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/linear/gdn_backend.py
  python/sglang/test/kits/attention_unittest/attention_methods/gdn_attention.py
  test/registered/attention/unittests/gdn/test_triton.py
  test/registered/unit/layers/test_gdn_mis_metadata.py
)
ruff check --select F401,F821,F823,UP037 "${files[@]}"  # PASS
ruff format --check "${files[@]}"                     # PASS
isort --check-only "${files[@]}"                      # PASS
python3 scripts/lint/check_registered_tests.py         # PASS
python3 scripts/lint/check_no_registered_tests_in_package.py  # PASS
python3 scripts/lint/check_no_bare_pytest_main.py "${files[@]}"  # PASS
git diff --check db90f584d2f4ab15f0823f82614ec7dce23e5dcd  # PASS
```

</details>

- [x] Local code review completed

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

Same H200/model/runtime, comparing original MIS with this fix only. Synthetic workload: 120-token shared query, ten 180-token items, raw HTTP `/v1/score`, `apply_softmax=false`, concurrency 1. Radix cache, CUDA graphs and chunked prefill are disabled in both versions.

Three 60-second trials per version, ten excluded warmups per trial, matched item-order seeds 42/43/44 and interleaved server starts. Server/client threads use disjoint CPU sets 0-23/24-29. Timed runs are uninstrumented.

| Mode | Items/s | P50 request latency | P99 request latency |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Original MIS | 149.962167 | 66.459236 ms | 70.186946 ms |
| This fix | 150.438051 | 66.476722 ms | 70.072441 ms |

Values are medians of the three trial metrics. All 5,406 timed requests succeed with zero errors; 60 warmup requests are excluded. Matched-seed throughput deltas are +0.44%, -0.82%, -0.32% (median -0.32%); comparing median rates gives +0.32%.

## Checklist

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.

files.patch:
@@ -89,7 +89,7 @@ class GDNMISMetadata(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
 
 
 def build_gdn_mis_metadata(forward_batch: ForwardBatch) -> GDNMISMetadata:
-    """Build compact query/item segments from request-local MIS delimiters."""
+    """Build item-only segments, retaining delimiter readouts for empty items."""
     if not forward_batch.is_prefill_only:
         raise ValueError("GDN MIS is only supported for prefill-only requests")
 
@@ -139,11 +139,14 @@ def build_gdn_mis_metadata(forward_batch: ForwardBatch) -> GDNMISMetadata:
             query_seq_lens_cpu.append(query_len)
             query_request_indices.append(request_idx)
 
-        branch_ends = delimiters[1:] + [seq_len]
-        for branch_start, branch_end in zip(delimiters, branch_ends):
-            branch_len = branch_end - branch_start
+        for branch_start, branch_end in zip(delimiters, delimiters[1:]):
+            item_start = branch_start + 1
+            if item_start == branch_end:
+                # Preserve the existing delimiter readout for an empty item.
+                item_start = branch_start
+            branch_len = branch_end - item_start
             item_token_indices.extend(
-                range(request_start + branch_start, request_start + branch_end)
+                range(request_start + item_start, request_start + branch_end)
             )
             item_seq_lens_cpu.append(branch_len)
             item_request_indices.append(request_idx)

@@ -821,7 +821,7 @@ def _pure_torch_gdn_reference(
     k = k.float()
     v = v.float()
 
-    outputs = torch.empty(
+    outputs = torch.zeros(
         1,
         fixture.case.num_input_tokens,
         fixture.case.num_v_heads,
@@ -840,7 +840,12 @@ def _pure_torch_gdn_reference(
         if fixture.case.mis_delimiter_indices:
             delimiters = fixture.case.mis_delimiter_indices[req_idx]
             segments = [(0, delimiters[0])]
-            segments.extend(zip(delimiters, tuple(delimiters[1:]) + (input_len,)))
+            for start_pos, end_pos in zip(delimiters[:-1], delimiters[1:]):
+                segments.append(
+                    (start_pos + 1, end_pos)
+                    if end_pos > start_pos + 1
+                    else (start_pos, end_pos)
+                )
         else:
             segments = [(0, input_len)]
 
@@ -898,15 +903,20 @@ def _pure_torch_mis_conv_reference(fixture: GDNAttentionFixture) -> torch.Tensor
 
     weights = fixture.actual_module.attn.conv_weights.float()
     width = weights.shape[1]
-    result = torch.empty_like(fixture.mixed_qkv)
+    result = torch.zeros_like(fixture.mixed_qkv)
     request_start = 0
     for request_idx, input_len in enumerate(fixture.case.input_lens):
         request_input = fixture.mixed_qkv[
             request_start : request_start + input_len
         ].float()
         delimiters = fixture.case.mis_delimiter_indices[request_idx]
         segments = [(0, delimiters[0])]
-        segments.extend(zip(delimiters, tuple(delimiters[1:]) + (input_len,)))
+        for start_pos, end_pos in zip(delimiters[:-1], delimiters[1:]):
+            segments.append(
+                (start_pos + 1, end_pos)
+                if end_pos > start_pos + 1
+                else (start_pos, end_pos)
+            )
 
         query_state = torch.zeros(
             width - 1,

@@ -241,12 +241,27 @@ def test_multi_item_scoring_crosses_chunk_boundaries(self):
             num_v_heads=2,
             page_size=1,
             prefix_lens=(0,),
-            extend_lens=(198,),
-            mis_delimiter_indices=((5, 68, 132, 197),),
+            extend_lens=(201,),
+            mis_delimiter_indices=((5, 69, 134, 200),),
             conv_history_weight=0.25,
         )
         run_gdn_attention_case(self, case, max_context_len=256)
 
+    def test_multi_item_scoring_empty_item_readouts(self):
+        case = GDNAttentionCase(
+            name="gdn_mis_empty_item_readouts",
+            backend="triton",
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+            num_k_heads=2,
+            num_v_heads=2,
+            page_size=1,
+            prefix_lens=(0, 0),
+            extend_lens=(6, 6),
+            mis_delimiter_indices=((0, 1, 4, 5), (3, 4, 5)),
+            conv_history_weight=0.25,
+        )
+        run_gdn_attention_case(self, case)
+
     # Layout-robustness. See dense/test_triton.py for the rationale.
     # shuffled_pages is the default for all tests; this method opts
     # into the more aggressive interleaved_pages + non_monotonic_extend.

@@ -4,13 +4,55 @@
 import torch
 
 from sglang.srt.layers.attention.linear.gdn_backend import build_gdn_mis_metadata
+from sglang.srt.layers.pooler import pool_at_delimiter_positions
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
 
 register_cpu_ci(est_time=11, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
 
 
 class TestGDNMISMetadata(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_only_real_items_and_empty_item_readouts_are_processed(self):
+        """Skip delimiters except when they are the existing empty-item readout."""
+        for query_len, item_lens in (
+            (3, [2]),
+            (0, [2, 1]),
+            (2, [0, 2, 0]),
+            (0, [0]),
+            (3, [0, 0]),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(query_len=query_len, item_lens=item_lens):
+                delimiters = []
+                expected_segments = []
+                offset = query_len
+                for item_len in item_lens:
+                    delimiters.append(offset)
+                    if item_len:
+                        expected_segments.append(
+                            list(range(offset + 1, offset + 1 + item_len))
+                        )
+                    else:
+                        expected_segments.append([offset])
+                    offset += item_len + 1
+                delimiters.append(offset)
+                forward_batch = SimpleNamespace(
+                    input_ids=torch.empty(offset + 1, dtype=torch.int64),
+                    extend_seq_lens_cpu=[offset + 1],
+                    extend_prefix_lens_cpu=[0],
+                    multi_item_delimiter_indices=[
+                        torch.tensor(delimiters, dtype=torch.int64)
+                    ],
+                    is_prefill_only=True,
+                )
